The error occurred because your interactive shell is **`fish`**, but the script was written in **`bash`** syntax. In `fish`, variable assignment does not use `VAR=value` (it uses `set VAR value`), loops use `end` instead of `do ... done`, and command substitutions differ.

---

### Solution 1: Run it directly in `bash` (Fastest & Recommended)

Simply launch a `bash` subshell so you don't have to rewrite the script syntax:

```bash
bash -c '
cd /home/prem/Projects/AppleTV
mkdir -p .agents/raw_transcripts

# 1. Copy main session logs individually
MAIN_BRAIN="/home/prem/.config/AntigravityManager/profiles/0a687723-2b9e-410c-849a-39cdb95fe290/home/.gemini/antigravity/brain/ffbf00b0-14b0-45fb-a910-ca3aa8b97a04/.system_generated/logs"
if [ -d "$MAIN_BRAIN" ]; then
    [ -f "$MAIN_BRAIN/transcript.jsonl" ] && cp "$MAIN_BRAIN/transcript.jsonl" .agents/raw_transcripts/main_session_transcript.jsonl
    [ -f "$MAIN_BRAIN/transcript_full.jsonl" ] && cp "$MAIN_BRAIN/transcript_full.jsonl" .agents/raw_transcripts/main_session_transcript_full.jsonl
fi

# 2. Copy all subagent brain folders
for brain_dir in /home/prem/.config/AntigravityManager/profiles/*/home/.gemini/antigravity/brain/*; do
    conv_id=$(basename "$brain_dir")
    log_dir="$brain_dir/.system_generated/logs"
    if [ -f "$log_dir/transcript.jsonl" ]; then
        cp "$log_dir/transcript.jsonl" ".agents/raw_transcripts/${conv_id}_transcript.jsonl"
    fi
    if [ -f "$log_dir/transcript_full.jsonl" ]; then
        cp "$log_dir/transcript_full.jsonl" ".agents/raw_transcripts/${conv_id}_transcript_full.jsonl"
    fi
done

# 3. Check file sizes, stage, and push
git status
git add -f .agents/raw_transcripts/
git commit -m "chore: archive raw session transcripts for main agent and subagents"
git push origin main
'
```

---

### Solution 2: Native `fish` Shell Syntax

If you prefer executing the commands directly in your active `fish` prompt:

```fish
cd /home/prem/Projects/AppleTV
mkdir -p .agents/raw_transcripts

# 1. Main session logs
set MAIN_BRAIN "/home/prem/.config/AntigravityManager/profiles/0a687723-2b9e-410c-849a-39cdb95fe290/home/.gemini/antigravity/brain/ffbf00b0-14b0-45fb-a910-ca3aa8b97a04/.system_generated/logs"
if test -d "$MAIN_BRAIN"
    test -f "$MAIN_BRAIN/transcript.jsonl"; and cp "$MAIN_BRAIN/transcript.jsonl" .agents/raw_transcripts/main_session_transcript.jsonl
    test -f "$MAIN_BRAIN/transcript_full.jsonl"; and cp "$MAIN_BRAIN/transcript_full.jsonl" .agents/raw_transcripts/main_session_transcript_full.jsonl
end

# 2. Subagent logs loop
for brain_dir in /home/prem/.config/AntigravityManager/profiles/*/home/.gemini/antigravity/brain/*
    set conv_id (basename "$brain_dir")
    set log_dir "$brain_dir/.system_generated/logs"
    if test -f "$log_dir/transcript.jsonl"
        cp "$log_dir/transcript.jsonl" ".agents/raw_transcripts/{$conv_id}_transcript.jsonl"
    end
    if test -f "$log_dir/transcript_full.jsonl"
        cp "$log_dir/transcript_full.jsonl" ".agents/raw_transcripts/{$conv_id}_transcript_full.jsonl"
    end
end

# 3. Stage and push
git status
git add -f .agents/raw_transcripts/
git commit -m "chore: archive raw session transcripts for main agent and subagents"
git push origin main
```

---

### ⚠️ Important GitHub Size Warning
Before running `git push`, verify that no single `.jsonl` file exceeds **100 MB** (GitHub will reject the push):
```bash
find .agents/raw_transcripts/ -type f -size +95M
```
If any `transcript_full.jsonl` exceeds 100 MB, compress it (e.g. `gzip`) or only commit the compact `transcript.jsonl` version.
